Experimental settings — not recommended for normal use
The options below are intentionally disabled by default. They change application network behavior and may cause compatibility problems. Use them only if you understand the consequences.
These settings are not recommended for normal use. They may break websites, calls, games, local devices, and apps. Continue?
Rejects detected QUIC in user TUN traffic. Browsers usually fall back to HTTPS over TCP, but some apps may lose performance or connectivity.
Rejects detected STUN in the TUN. This can reduce WebRTC network leaks, but may break calls, P2P, games, and media connectivity.
Rejects detected plain HTTP from apps. Non-HTTPS sites, captive portals, and some connectivity checks may stop working.
Rejects TUN application traffic to private LAN addresses. Printers, TVs, routers, NAS devices, and other local services may become unavailable.
A VPN cannot globally change the User-Agent, operating system, browser, Canvas/WebGL, or other data carried inside HTTPS. This mode does not decrypt HTTPS and does not guarantee complete anonymity.
Configure regional app rules, Russian domains and IP ranges, and extra domain rules. Turning a category off preserves its saved selections. App exclusions also depend on your VPN per-app settings.
Full tunnel takes priority over direct exceptions. These saved rules apply when full tunnel is disabled.

TCP: AnyTLS and Naive with verified TLS. VLESS/VMess and unverifiable chains are excluded. Requires compatible servers; otherwise connection stops. Masking cannot guarantee bypass of DPI or IP/SNI blocks.

Adds Hysteria 2, TUIC and Naive HTTP/3 to the masked protocol selection. Disable if UDP is blocked. Hysteria obfuscation must match the server. This setting is separate from blocking app QUIC traffic.
Enables adaptive core bandwidth, server selection and longer probe deadlines. The native health check tolerates slower responses and pauses while the underlying network is offline.
The home screen checks internet through the selected core outbound while the app is visible. A failed check does not automatically stop or restart the VPN.

Retry unexpected service failures with bounded backoff while this app is visible. Manual disconnect and VPN permission revocation cancel retries. Adaptive mode also enables recovery.
